tenderSchedule.title: Providing Services of Pre-Audit Services and Supervisory Audit for a period of one year for Mysuru Zone of KRIDL
tenderSchedule.description: Providing Services of Pre-Audit Services and Supervisory Audit for a period of one year for Mysuru Zone of KRIDL

tenderAddress.blockNumber: 4th floor, Anand Rao Circle, Gandhi Nagar

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

Tenderer shall be permitted to apply for a maximum of two (2) Zones only. If a Tenderer applies for two (2) Zones, the Technical and Financial Qualification criteria shall be considered cumulatively for two (2) Zones
All Other Conditions as per tender Document

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Firm should have minimum five years experience in preparation of accounts of State PSU / State Boards / Central PSUs or for any Organisations of Government of Karnataka /Private limited infrastructure companies having an annual turnover of not less than Rs 1000 crores during the relevant period.
Chartered Accountant firm having experience in Financial Audit services at any level for Karnataka State infrastructure development PSUs in past 3 years
Chartered Accountant firm having experience in Financial Audit services / Consultancy at any level for Central infrastructure development PSUs in past 3 years
Chartered Accountant firm having experience in GST, Income tax , TDS works for any PSU
Atleast 6 number of Chartered Accountants as partners with FCA Qualification having atleast 5 years of association with the firm
Atleast 6 No. of CAs as employees
Chartered Accountants firm having experience in pre-audit / Consultancy /Statutory Audit of any state / Central P.S.U / body / Organisation having at least 30 branches
Firm Should have Minimum average annual financial turnover of 5.00 crore at least in last three financial Years.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Adequacy of the proposed work plan & methodology in responding to the TOR.
